newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SPORT-SAFRICA'S NSC NAMES SPORTSPEOPLE OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SPORT-SAFRICA'S NSC NAMES SPORTSPEOPLE OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Olympic gold medalists Josia Thugwane and Penny Heyns were named as sportsman and sportswoman of the year by the National Sports Council at the weekend.

Marathon winner Thugwane and double breaststroke gold medalist Heyns held off the challenge of fellow Olympic medalists Hezekiel Sepeng and Marianne Kriel to take South Africa's foremost sports awards.
Sportsman of the year: Josia Thugwane
Sportswoman of the year: Penny Heyns
Young sportsman of the year: Quinton Fortune
Junior sportsman of the year: Natalie Grainger
Disabled sportsman of the year: Fanie Lombard
Disabled sportswoman of the year: Deirdre Buller.
